note: SailTube's outbound host inventory (NFR-SEC-01), checked by tests/privacy/run.sh with SailTune's pinned checker. Only the hosts of SAILTUBE_REQUIREMENTS NFR-SEC-01 may ever appear here. A file that starts using a host is added to that host's 'files' in the same commit, together with docs/PRIVACY_NETWORK.md. No analytics, advertising, telemetry or crash-upload endpoint may be added.

www.youtube.com.purpose: Anonymous stream lookup: watch page through the bundled yt-dlp child, and the shared fast path's visitor id and player requests; catalog component: anonymous InnerTube WEB discovery (search, browse, next, resolve_url, player, reel item and reel sequence for Shorts), the caption track list of a playing video (player with the shared fast path's client description and a visitor id kept in memory only, visitor_id when no answer has named one), the homepage client-version scrape, channel RSS feeds and caption tracks (api/timedtext); a connection opened ahead of a search (TCP + TLS only, no HTTP request: 1.5 s after start, on return to the foreground, on the first typed character)
www.youtube.com.trigger: the user opens or plays a video (prefetch: a video the user is about to open); the user searches, opens a list, channel, playlist or watch page, the feed refreshes subscribed channels, captions are shown
www.youtube.com.sends: video id and a fixed public client description; a provider visitor id in memory only; no cookies, key, account or device identifier
www.youtube.com.authenticated_note: Optional signed-in session (ACC-06/07/09, IMP-02), only after the user imports one: InnerTube WEB POSTs (account/account_menu, account/accounts_list, browse) with the imported cookies, a fresh SAPISIDHASH, Origin, Referer, X-Goog-AuthUser and, for a brand channel, X-Goog-PageId. Sent only to https://www.youtube.com by the account's own transport (no cookie jar of its own, no redirects followed). Signed out, nothing is sent.

youtube.com.purpose: Host suffix accepted for live HLS manifests returned by the resolver (RES-22); no request of its own; also recognised in imported or pasted links (library import), where no request is made; recognised in opened, pasted and description links (catalog component, LNK-01/02); no request of its own

googlevideo.com.purpose: Host suffix of media addresses accepted from the resolver (RES-22); the request goes to the resolved *.googlevideo.com host

.googlevideo.com.purpose: Media bytes of the chosen streams (probe, Range chunks through the loopback proxy, DASH fragments); downloads of the chosen streams (DL-02, Range resume); redirects followed only to https *.googlevideo.com, at most three hops (MediaAddress.h, shared by probe and proxy)
.googlevideo.com.sends: the signed media address and fixed client headers

127.0.0.1.purpose: Shared media proxy: serves resolved streams to the local pipeline with a session token; never leaves the device. [FULL] Optional PO-token helper (RES-14): the yt-dlp child asks the user-enabled bgutil HTTP provider for a token at its verified 127.0.0.1 base URL; SailTube itself only reads /proc socket tables to verify the bind
127.0.0.1.trigger: playback through the shared component; [FULL] an extractor resolve while the user-enabled PO-token helper is ready and the request asks for it
127.0.0.1.sends: nothing external; to the PO helper: the extractor's token request (video id, client context), no cookies

i.ytimg.com.purpose: Video thumbnails (addresses come from the resolver or catalog answers at run time); saved thumbnail of a download (DL-07)
i.ytimg.com.trigger: a list or video page is shown

.ytimg.com.purpose: Thumbnail host suffix (i9.ytimg.com and similar) accepted by the shared image cache; image addresses come from catalog answers. Storyboard sheets for the scrub preview: the resolver keeps a sheet address only when it is https on this suffix under /sb/ (the image cache fetches it)

.ytimg.com.sends: the thumbnail or storyboard sheet address

dynamic_network_sources.name: Resolved media and thumbnail addresses
dynamic_network_sources.detail: Hosts of stream, manifest and thumbnail addresses come from the resolver at run time. Stream addresses are accepted only by acceptedMediaUrl (https, port 443, *.googlevideo.com /videoplayback; HLS also youtube.com) and the shared parser's googlevideo rule.
dynamic_network_sources.trigger: user plays a video or views a list

dynamic_network_sources.name: [FULL] PO-token helper (RES-14)
dynamic_network_sources.detail: Opt-in, off by default, aarch64 only. A separate Deno process running the pinned bgutil HTTP provider (Core/Resolver/Infrastructure/PoTokenProvider.cpp, command line in Core/Resolver/Domain/PoTokenPolicy.cpp). Its own network use is unrestricted by design (Deno --allow-net; a host allow-list killed token minting) and is the provider's: it contacts the provider's attestation endpoints while minting a token, and its frozen install fetches the locked npm/JSR packages. It reads only its own directory and may not write, run programs or load native code. SailTube talks to it on 127.0.0.1 only and refuses and stops it if any of its sockets listens elsewhere. It never gets cookies, account data or the app's environment.
dynamic_network_sources.trigger: the user enables the PO-token provider (install and start), then extractor resolves while it is ready

dynamic_network_sources.name: yt-dlp / QuickJS resolver child
dynamic_network_sources.detail: The bundled resolver process contacts the provider on its own while a user-initiated search or resolution runs; static analysis of its code is out of scope.
dynamic_network_sources.trigger: user searches or plays a video

build_permissions.note: Reviewed baseline of what the package may request (PLT-04). A change is a privacy decision: edit together with docs/PRIVACY_NETWORK.md. Local-only additions: sql + sqlite driver (library store), zlib (import archives), Nemo.Notifications (download finished), Sailfish.Pickers (import file), DownloadsView (the downloads page and section) opens a downloaded local file in the system player until PLY-26.
